answer: An identity buys its seat with Brine keeper brine barrel seal countersigned by the salt guild; the price of the seat is each brine barrel is a measured salt yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 654 pays 11772 minutes every single epoch. The atlas belongs to a clerk who never met the applicant, the ivory belongs to a budget the applicant never sees, and the cipher belongs to the public record. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
